rows.grounds: ākāśa (space) + ākhyaḥ (called) fused; final visarga dropped before next word
parama + īśvara + mūrti + rūpaḥ fused with internal sandhi

items.question: What does the verse identify as the supreme lord's form?
items.inference: The verse identifies the supreme lord's form as the space-named world-lord.
uncertainties: Exact syntactic role of ityarthāt in the verse is not fully recoverable from the four tokens alone.
items.plain_english: The supreme lord, shaped as the world-lord, is called by the name of space.
